name: Carbone
description: Fills your company's Word, Excel, PowerPoint and HTML templates with data from the chat and returns PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint files: invoices, quotes, contracts, certificates, statements, labels and reports, one at a time or in batches. Also designs new templates, manages your Carbone template library, and protects PDFs with watermarks or passwords.

disclaimer.text: Copilot prepares data and new templates with AI and can make mistakes; Carbone renders your template exactly as designed. Check every value before you share or send a document. To report harmful or inappropriate content, email support@carbone.io.
